structured_output.what_is_happening: A 51-minute-old Solana PumpSwap pair called ARGUS 'Argus' traded about $1.5M in volume in its first hour and rose 70-114%. It borrows the identity of Argus (@Arguspad), the leading token launchpad on Circle's Arc L1. That project's ARGUS token launched Sept 2, 2026 and reached a $38M market cap after Arc mainnet opened on Sept 16. GeckoTerminal links this Solana pool to @arguspad and argus.world. I found nothing from Argus announcing a Solana token. The Argus sites were behind traffic checks, and a KuCoin write-up of Argus doesn't mention Solana. The pool was seeded directly on PumpSwap with about 187 SOL, not through a pump.fun bonding curve (launchpad null, migrated 0). Liquidity (about $41-44K) is larger than market cap (about $29-33K), the pool holds about 666M tokens, and the LP is 0% locked or burned. Trade flow is lopsided: 2,061 unique buyers against only 59 unique sellers. Those 59 sellers made about 1,500 sells, which points to a small group selling into a wide set of small buyers. That could be buy bots, or people who think this is an official Solana listing of the Arc token.

narrative.description: The borrowed story is the real Argus launchpad on Circle's Arc chain, which was the first breakout of the Arc era in September 2026. On Solana, this is a copycat or impersonation token, not an extension of the project.
narrative.why_spreading: The Arc/Argus story is real and recent, which likely makes people searching ARGUS on Solana think they've found an early or bridged listing. I found no organic Solana discussion of this contract on X, Reddit, Telegram or news. The flow of 2,061 buyers against 59 sellers looks more like engineered distribution than organic spread.

token_connection.why_this_token: Its only link is the name and ticker plus a GeckoTerminal social field pointing to @arguspad and argus.world. Anyone deploying a token can set that field. Argus is an Arc-native launchpad, and I found no Solana deployment announced by the project.
token_connection.competing_tokens: The canonical ARGUS is on Arc (CoinMarketCap: argus-arc, about $20M market cap). On Solana there are at least 4 other same-name ARGUS tokens, including two with claimed $16-20M liquidity and zero volume, which looks like fake or unusable liquidity. There is also an 'Arguspad' token (HV31t3...) with 35 holders. This one is just one copycat among many.

authenticity.evidence: Only 59 unique sellers made about 1,500 sells, against 2,061 unique buyers. The creator seeded a PumpSwap pool directly with about 187 SOL, the LP is unlocked (RugCheck: 'Large Amount of LP Unlocked', 'Low amount of LP Providers'), GeckoTerminal says the dev holds over 10%, and GT's security score is 47/100. The social links borrow the real Arc project's handle. GMGN shows no smart or renowned wallets and no calls. I found no organic posts about the contract.
authenticity.uncertainty: GMGN shows 0 bundlers, 0 snipers and a 0% bot/degen rate, and I couldn't see X directly (402 error), so there could be real retail confusion flow. The buyer/seller asymmetry could partly be a GeckoTerminal counting artifact.

structural_risks: The LP is 0% locked or burned, so the creator can pull about $41K of liquidity at any time
Top 10 holders hold 91% (including the pool, which holds about 66% of supply)
Liquidity is larger than market cap on a non-pump.fun pool the dev seeded directly
59 sellers are selling steadily into 2,000+ buyers
Price already fell 28% over the last 15 minutes, from an ATH of about $6.66e-5 to $2.9e-5
It impersonates a real project, which invites a denial from Argus and the price dropping

structured_output.counterargument: Arc/Argus is a hot, real, very recent story, and Solana traders often push up bridged or ticker-matched plays. More than 2,000 unique buyers in an hour is real breadth, and GMGN flags no bundlers or snipers. If Argus ever acknowledged a Solana presence, or if the confusion spreads, volume could last longer than the window.
unknowns: Whether Argus/@Arguspad has said anything about Solana (X was inaccessible)
Who seeded the 187 SOL of LP, and whether it will be pulled
Whether the 2,061 buyers are real people or bot-generated

source_coverage.notes: X returned 402. The contract-address search returned nothing. News coverage exists only for the Arc-chain Argus. arguspad.io and argus.world showed only traffic checks. DexScreener returned 403, and GeckoTerminal fetched fine.

structured_output.thesis: A Solana copycat of Argus, the real Arc-chain launchpad. The creator seeded the pool with liquidity that isn't locked, and a small group of sellers is selling steadily into many buyers. There is no canonical link and no organic discussion. It has high rug and fade risk.
